title: The Hollywood Blonds mock the establishment
summary: Steve Austin and Brian Pillman turn a new partnership into championship success. Their camera gestures and taunts at the Horsemen make them targets for the veterans they ridicule.

chapters.title: The Blonds win the tag titles
chapters.result: Austin and Pillman defeat Steamboat and Douglas for the tag championships.
chapters.context: A belt shot helps the challengers win; the date is the television broadcast rather than the earlier recording.

chapters.title: The Horsemen win the match, but not the belts
chapters.result: Flair and Anderson win two falls, one by disqualification.
chapters.context: Windham’s interference causes the disqualification, so the Blonds retain despite losing the two-out-of-three-falls match.
